statements.t: We believe that exiting these initiatives, together with the ongoing benefits of Renewal, will enable us to further simplify the business, reduce operating expenses, and strengthen our financial position.”

Renewal targeted the closure of 4 of the Company’s studios, the elimination of 177 positions, the consolidation of products and development teams, the unification of select technologies and tools, reductions in cost of sales, and lower marketing spend.

To date, the Company has closed all 4 studios, exceeded its targeted role eliminations, and surpassed its cost of sales reduction goals, driven by the continued shift toward direct-to-consumer revenue.
The Company is on pace to realize annualized savings at the top end of the initial forecast range, now raising and narrowing the range to $37.0 million to $39.0 million.

The Company has adopted a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan and expects to continue repurchasing shares of its Class A common stock under its remaining $44.6 million of authorization as of the date of this press release, subject to market conditions, applicable legal requirements, and other considerations.
Management remains committed to transparency and intends to continue engaging with investors and analysts regarding the Company’s progress and priorities.
